ConfigurableProduct:26250.faq:
What age group is this daycare supplies combo for?

This personalised daycare supplies combo is perfect for kids in daycare, kindy and early Primary. The backpack size is ideal for little shoulders while still being roomy enough for daily essentials.

Does the lunch bag fit inside the daycare backpack?

Yes. The kids lunch bag fits comfortably inside the daycare backpack, and the bento lunch box fits perfectly inside the lunch bag.

Are the materials safe for kids?

Absolutely. All items in this daycare set are BPA Free, PVC Free and Phthalate Free.

Can I order without my child’s name?

Yes. Simply enter spaces in the name field and we’ll print the design without personalisation.

Everything coordinates. Everything fits inside each other. And everything is made to survive busy daycare days.
